full_page.content:
1924, November
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 17 Cont.
Nov. 1st Non catholic Enrolled for restoration of Health - Doctors Hopeless
5 Joseph Burczzk away from confession 12-15 yrs. Enrolled tonight by his anxious sister Mr. Burkheiser 6180 Seneca
15 Patrick murphy enrolled his boarding Mistress-non-catholic - Nov. 4th - despairing of roomers, etc. Mrs. reports to-day success evident - three roomers already.
18 Gall-Kidney-Stones cured. Mrs. Margaret S. Homan (45) of 1063 E. Gr. Boulevard. Enrolled Sept. 6th against terrible Kidney stones. She was to have operation which took place on Sept. 9. Operation surprisingly successful as also the rapid recovery. Today returns to report as perfectly cured after 7 years suffering.
Enrolled against for Cateract on both eyes & Deafness. Richard Mtgomery, 75 of 1063 East Gr. Boulv. deaf since 14 years old, is enrolled To-day for releaf.
18 J. W. Hanrahan (57) 2845 Lawton away from Sacraments for years to Mass twice a year Wife enrolles him for year with promise for perpetual enrollment if results is shown.
18 Br. McKenna - away from Family about three months Enrolled for year for intention she may return
K.K. Ks enrolled by Catholic neighbor. Yeates Family of Holcomb & Forest, bitter haters of Catholic -- is enrolled To-day by lat- ter that they may be more reasonable.
20 Suecide Positively Averted. James John Kulick 37 of 4933 Vinwood, makes all prepares for death by suicide - final will in all details, even to choice of coffin, ready to go on boat to Cleveland. His two sisters receiving leaflets and word of explanation at Father's funeral, about S.M. Assoc. Enrolles their desperate brother that day - October 16. Today sister Grace returns in tears of joy that every vistage of danger disapeared that night - her brother now in hope and praying. To go to work Nov. 24. To-day enrolls her other Br. Ed as against tuberculosis - April 18 Same Br. Edw'd re- ported in perfect health; Deo Gr!
Page 18 Nov. 23 Pneumonia to be cured. Mrs. Mary Jacob (57 Jan. 14) 5393 Iroquois Ave. Married 41 years To-day is reported as unconscious with pneu- monia and enrolled for year by anxious daughters:
